metadata.title: Every Link Has Infinitely Many Explicit Generalised T-Link Presentations
metadata.abstract: Generalised $T$-links provide a simple description of all links in $S^3$ as closures of products of standard twisting blocks, parametrised by finite sequences of integers. We prove that every link admits infinitely many pairwise distinct generalised $T$-link presentations. Starting from any such presentation, we give explicit parameter transformations that preserve the represented link and generate families of pairwise distinct presentations depending on arbitrarily many independent integer parameters.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 链环表示的显式无限族
analysis.workSummary: 从任一广义 T-link 表示出发，给出保持链环类型的整数参数变换，产生任意多独立参数的无限多个不同表示。
analysis.breakthrough: 把每个链环表示的不唯一性组织为显式可操作的参数族。
analysis.limitations: 不同的是表示而非链环类型；不提供新的链环分类不变量。
analysis.priorityReason: 把每个链环表示的不唯一性组织为显式可操作的参数族。
